entries.exactBehavior: The actual typed hash input uses the reference multiline placeholder and vertical four-type radio group (SHA-256, MD5, SHA-1, SHA-512), alongside its existing is/is-not group. Arrow navigation clamps at edges and Space selects. Upper/lower case, allowed algorithm prefixes, 0x prefixes and duplicate newline-separated hashes reach the existing typed query consumer; inclusive/exclusive and empty sets have recorded live query outcomes. Invalid or wrong-type acceptance preserves the draft and presents the exact prefixed Qt OK warning in an owned notice. Live physical text remains synchronized after cleanup, including an empty result. Cancel publishes nothing; explicit typed reconstruction preserves algorithm/sign in the model, while typed custom defaults persist/reopen natively and keep other default families. Hidden, rebound and permanently closed owners cannot accept retained callbacks. Main-owned lifetime state retires the editor on actual Main-component destruction or final Bound-owner drop as well as rebind/accepted exit, hides owned notices and clears only its own slot. Nonfinal Bound clones, temporary Main hide and pending/declined exit retain the draft; retired/re-shown callbacks and Return cannot publish or change recents/defaults.
